name: Cardiff Metropolitan University

settingEvidence.evidence: The campus is located approximately two miles from the city centre, surrounded by numerous parks, playing fields and the historic village of Llandaff.

fees.text: £9,790 per year for full-time Home undergraduate students starting in 2027/28. The page says the fee may be subject to increase by any level permitted by the Welsh Government. A year-long undergraduate placement is charged £1,955.

source.evidence: Full-Time Home Students | Programme | Fee (£) | Undergraduate Students | 9,790*

livingCosts.text: Plas Gwyn halls (close to the Llandaff Campus where these courses are taught) cost £156–£175 a week for self-catered ensuite rooms on a 42-week contract. Cyncoed halls cost £156–£225 a week (catered rooms £196–£225). The room pages do not say which academic year the rents are for.

source.evidence: £156pw – 42-week contract

openDays.text: Next undergraduate open day: Saturday 7 November 2026, 9:30am to 4:30pm. No later dates are listed yet.

source.evidence: Saturday 7 November 9:30am to 4:30pm

contextual.summary: Applicants with Home fee status who meet Cardiff Met's contextual criteria are typically given an offer one grade lower; it is worked out from your UCAS application, so you do not apply separately.
contextual.typicalReduction: Typically one grade (or the equivalent in points) below the published standard entry requirements

criteria.detail: Spent time in care (identified through information on the UCAS application).
Young carers (identified through information on the UCAS application).
Having parents/guardians who have not attended university (identified through information on the UCAS application).
Live in an area with low progression to Higher Education (POLAR score). The university considers applicants from POLAR4 quintiles 1 and 2.
Welsh, English, Scottish and Northern Irish Indexes of multiple deprivation (no threshold stated).
Attendance at a school with lower than average participation to Higher Education or those that have a higher number of students from low participation neighbourhoods.
Completed an accredited Widening Participation programme at Cardiff Met.
Applicants covered by the Armed Forces Covenant: those who serve or have served in the UK Armed Forces, whether Regular or Reserve, and their families and dependents.

Cardiff Met also uses UCAS Multiple Equality Measure (MEM) data, which combines sex, ethnic group, where you live (POLAR), school sector (state or private) and income background (free school meals) into one score.

Other personal circumstances that have negatively impacted your post 16 studies (for example disability, being estranged from your parents, or being a refugee or asylum seeker): tell Admissions at askadmissions@cardiffmet.ac.uk if you cannot meet the published entry requirements.

contextual.rulesText: If you are identified as meeting the specified criteria and are offered a place, you will receive an adjusted conditional offer, typically one grade (or the equivalent in points) below the published standard entry requirements. Course-specific conditions (for example a minimum grade in a subject) still apply. All courses are included, the policy only applies to applicants with Home fee status, and Cardiff Met can only use data supplied at the time of application.

source.evidence: you will receive an adjusted conditional offer. Typically, this will be one grade (or the equivalent in points) below the published standard entry requirements.

courses.notes: Specialist pathways (3-year UCAS codes): Entrepreneurship N1NS, Finance M300, Human Resource Management M500, International Supply Chain and Logistics Management N1IT, Marketing M400 (all have a foundation-year version too). Study abroad for a semester or a full year is supported; the experiential work or volunteering module is compulsory in year 2.

notes: All six courses are taught at the Llandaff Campus (Cardiff School of Management) and show Entry Year 2027; no 2028-entry pages were found on 2026-10-21, so 2027 entry is used.

Offers are in UCAS tariff points: 112 for every course recorded, with a minimum of three A levels including grades CCC and no specific A level subjects; the Welsh Advanced Skills Baccalaureate counts as a third subject. GCSEs: five at grade C/4 or above including English Language (or Welsh First Language) and Mathematics (or Mathematics – Numeracy).
Cardiff Met is not on UAT-UK's TMUA list for 2027 entry and no course page names an admissions test.

Every degree also has a 4-year version with a foundation year (UCAS codes end in F; normally 32 UCAS tariff points from at least 1 A level or equivalent) and an optional year in industry between years 2 and 3.

Cardiff Met's Widening Access courses and Summer School are for adult learners (18+), so no programme suitable for a Year 12 student is recorded. Cardiff Met is a partner in the Reaching Wider programme (South East Wales) but its page gives no Year 12 activity details.
Not recorded: BSc (Hons) Applied Data, Statistical and Economic Analysis is a degree apprenticeship, not a standard full-time degree.
